content: Generative component. For the generative component of our model, we use a hierarchical recurrent encoder-decoder (HRED) architecture BIBREF60, a modified version of the popular sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) architecture BIBREF61 designed to account for dependencies between consecutive inputs. BIBREF23 showed that HRED can successfully model conversational context by encoding the temporal structure of previously seen comments, making it an ideal fit for our use case. Here, we provide a high-level summary of the HRED architecture, deferring deeper technical discussion to BIBREF60 and BIBREF23.
